scope: A bounded identity-only review of ten direct-P31 board-game items without P2339. A publisher-confirmed physical product may enter the pending-rule directory. A shared Wikidata title does not prove an edition match. No BoardGameGeek API, export, site page or scraper was used.

decisions.reason: The full runtime registry already enrolls Earth as bgg-350184 from the earlier P2339 Wikidata import. Inside Up Games confirms the physical base product as SKU IUG011, but the no-P2339 item and publisher page do not justify a second directory identity.

primarySource.location: Focal product title, SKU IUG011 and Board Games category

decisions.reason: Themeborne explicitly sells a physical First Edition base game and lists its components. The broader Wikidata item does not bind an edition; the directory identity is limited to the publisher's First Edition product.
